articles.summary: Businesses everywhere are under pressure. More complexity, more tools, more “best practices” piling up and somehow, things feel heavier than ever. But what if HR and leadership more broadly could feel lighter? What if instead of chasing endless checklists, we focused on just two meta skills that make everything else easier? That’s the vision shared by Susan Chen
articles.title: A Deep Dive into Ontological Leadership | Rozana Halpin
